# Design and dependencies

Why Wallpaper is built the way it is, what it needs from other ACO components, which libraries it uses and which versions it was tested with.

## Why it is built this way

- Hyprpaper only knows one image per instruction; the command adds **state** (default + overrides), folder search, a menu and restoring the assignment when a monitor is plugged in.
- The state lives outside the configuration (`~/.local/state`) so updates never overwrite it; images are not part of the package (copyright).

## What this configuration needs from others

| Component | Why |
| --- | --- |
| [Hyprland](https://aco-hypr.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) | `hyprctl` and `hyprpaper`; the session calls `wallpaper apply` at start and on plug-in |
| [Fuzzel](https://aco-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/fuzzel/) | Selection menu (`wallpaper` without arguments) |

## Who needs this configuration

| Component | Why |
| --- | --- |
| [Hyprland](https://aco-hypr.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) | Backgrounds at start and on `monitor.added`; `Super + Shift + W` |
| [Zsh](https://aco-zsh.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) | `wp` is the wallpaper command |

## Notes

- `hyprctl` ships with `hyprland`, which is a declared dependency; the command only makes sense inside a Hyprland session.

## Shared foundations

These rules apply to **every** ACO component:

- **One repository per component**, with its own `PKGBUILD` and CI. Each configuration can be installed, tested and developed on its own;
  after a push the central registry builds the signed package ([packaging overview](https://aco-arch-dotfiles.readthedocs.io/en/latest/arch-package/)).
- **Pacman is the only updater.** No git pull at runtime; `aco` only merges new defaults with your changes (`.pacnew`).
- **Your copy, not the package's.** `~/.config/<module>` points to `~/.local/share/arch-dotfiles/config/<module>/`; the package stays untouched in `/usr/share/arch-dotfiles/<module>/`.
- **One theme:** colours, fonts and rounding come from `aco-theme` templates in every component, so light/dark, accent and transparency switch everywhere at once.
- **The core** `aco-arch-dotfiles-core` (the `aco` command, activation, backups, synchronisation) is a dependency of every package.
